title: Charleston, SC — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

Overview

Charleston is a city in SC with a population of 150,227. Holy City with cobblestone streets, world-class food, and Southern coastal elegance. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
